source.title: Taste Testing
source.description:
Ok <race> buddy, it time for Skonk favorite part. Skonk have fire hot and ready, and want to share new dish with new friend. You do such big favors for Skonk; it only right you get some too!

Let Skonk know when you ready for tasting.
source.objective: Taste test the recipe with Skonk.
source.completion:
Mmm, recipe is delicious!

Skonk get a bit lost in passion of moment, but you were good helper!

Here, this your share. Skonk even add little something extra for your trouble.
